Swallowed Watermelon Seeds? The 5-Second Belly Truth! — You ate 1 watermelon seed by accident—could a vine sprout inside your belly?
Kids science answer for "swallowing watermelon seeds myth for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Stomach gastric acid breaks down food while seed shells pass safely through digestion; seeds need soil, water, and sunlight — not tummy acid — to sprout.
